phase: Phase 2: The print-audit block and the overview table (by Wed 2026-11-18)
summary: Round 5: the P2U1-1 bias-note fix is safe. The new bias_note renders through html.escape with an isinstance-string guard; an end-to-end /tmp probe with a hostile note holding a script tag, angle brackets, an ampersand, and both quote kinds shows the fully escaped text and no raw tag. print-audit.ts keeps its refusal semantics (missing summary exits 2 with input-check: keys and no output; a non-string bias_note yields null, as its header states). The regenerated data file is byte-identical to a fresh run on the real OD6 hand-off, adds only the bias_note item, and holds no book text, page, or file name. No new write path. All three suites green (117 tests). P2B4-1 and the two nits are carried as nonblocking.
nonblocking_findings: P2B5-1 [Major] review-b: carryover of P2B4-1, still open: preview.sh follows a symlinked .tmp parent and writes the preview outside the repo at exit 0. preview.sh:81 resolves PREVIEW_ABS with `realpath -m`, which follows a planted <repo>/.tmp link, and no refusal covers a symlinked parent of the default preview folder. Round 4 probe reproduced it in /tmp/opencode/p2b4-probe (the whole preview landed in the outside folder at exit 0). Rated Major, not Blocker: the header promises no in-repo containment (an operator-chosen --preview outside the repo is a supported mode), the final folder name is fixed, the written data is the public docs copy plus sanitized aggregates, and planting needs repo-root write access. Round 5 did not change the preview.sh guards. Fix suggestion for Green: when the default preview path is used, refuse when the resolved PREVIEW_ABS differs from the lexical $ROOT/.tmp/model-guide-preview, or apply the update.sh parent-chain -L walk to the preview default.

P2B5-2 [Nit] review-b: carryover of P2B4-2 (round 3 P2B2-3), still open per the round 5 brief: guide.ts readTrackARank defaults a missing or non-finite pass.blocker_recall to 0 instead of refusing, while a missing or non-finite date or score refuses with `input-check: scores`. The silent 0 only affects the first D13 tie-break key. guide.ts did not change in round 5.

P2B5-3 [Nit] review-b: carryover of P2B4-3 (round 1 P2B1-2, adversarial P2ADV-7/P2ADV2-3), still open per the round 5 brief: print-audit.ts reads the input file twice (text for the JSON parse at print-audit.ts:135, bytes for the SHA-256 at print-audit.ts:136), so the verified hash and the parsed content can come from different file states. Not exploitable in the hand-off threat model. The round 5 change to print-audit.ts touched only the output object.

P2B5-4 [Nit] review-b: the two new P2U1-1 tests pin the bias note's presence, its separate item, and its rendering, but no test pins the escaping of the new bias-note line with a hostile value, and no test pins the null output for a non-string bias_note. Both behaviors were verified empirically in this audit (the /tmp preview probe and the num-bias run) and both hold; the pins would keep them held. The existing T11 hostile-text pattern in preview-gate.test.ts is the natural home.
